examDefinition: Economies of Scale refers to the cost advantages that enterprises obtain due to their scale of operation, allowing hyperscalers like Microsoft to offer lower prices.
useCases: Accessing enterprise-grade hardware at pennies per hour
Global fiber optic backbone connectivity without capital investment
Continuous price reductions over cloud hardware generations
bestPractices: Evaluate pricing tiers periodically as newer hardware generations are released
Take advantage of shared multi-tenant service plans where appropriate
Use reserved instances to capture even deeper long-term volume discounts
